sources.title: Transgender woman released from a guarded center for male foreigners - Association for Legal Intervention
sources.claim_summary: Legal-intervention NGO case report (March 2024): a regional court confined a transgender Vietnamese woman, on hormone therapy since 2018, to a guarded detention centre for male foreigners; the Border Guard refused her medication and outside supplies, interrupting her therapy for three months despite the health-exception bar in the Act on Foreigners, and released her only after the NGO's demand and a medical opinion (police interrogated her partner's visa overstay on the way out). Nationally recurring mechanism, not tied to this voivodeship.

sources.title: ECtHR rules Polish prison authorities violated trans woman's rights by denying access to hormone therapy - TGEU - Trans Europe and Central AsiaTGEU – Trans Europe and Central Asia
sources.claim_summary: TGEU case report (July 2024): the European Court of Human Rights ruled on 11 July 2024 that Polish prison authorities violated a trans woman's Article 8 rights by denying her prescribed hormone replacement therapy at Siedlce prison (where she was held after a disciplinary transfer from Warsaw-II, with guards misgendering her and denying underclothing) until the European Court's interim measure; the Court awarded EUR 8,000 damages.

NOTE: page not retrievable at fetch time (uncached); the underlying source is a case-law digest entry on the same European Court judgment - a transgender prisoner denied hormone therapy in prison, violation of the right to private life.
